facts.fact: Interministerial order 011 of 14 October 2026 treats the GUCE foreign-trade single window as Togo's current principal system for goods formalities, with the GUFORD maritime single window beside it, until a Port Community System replaces both.

Interministerial order 011 of 14 October 2026 cites law 2018-026 of 7 December 2018 on cybersecurity and the fight against cybercrime, as amended by law 2022-009 of 24 June 2022, among its legal bases.
Interministerial order 011 of 14 October 2026 cites law 2019-014 of 29 October 2019 on the protection of personal data among its legal bases.

TGO.note: The order sets interoperability rules for the port and foreign-trade single windows only, a one-sector framework the study notes and does not place.
The order binds only maritime, port and foreign-trade formalities, a law for one sector the study notes and does not place.
